The suggested owner is Pricing & Billing Master Data.", "rebill_note_subject": "F-017 | Crestline Tooling Co | C-2007 | MFG-1004 - potential underbilling review", "rebill_note_body": "INTERNAL - for review and approval only. Not for customer distribution.

Finding F-017: Crestline Tooling Co, contract C-2007, SKU MFG-1004. Root cause: PARTIAL_ESCALATION (only some contractual anniversary escalations were applied in billing).

Basis: Clause A.2 (page 3) sets the price at USD 31.75 per unit. Clause 4.2 (page 1) provides an annual 3.5% uplift effective January 1, 2024 and annually thereafter. Contract calculation: USD 31.75 (base price) x (1 + 3.5%) [2024-01-01] x (1 + 3.5%) [2025-01-01] = USD 34.01. Latest billed unit price: USD 32.86.

Impact: 12 invoice lines, 2025-01-05 to 2025-12-05. Potential underbilling: USD 12,024.40. Estimated recoverable: USD 12,024.40.

Proposed actions, pending approval: (1) Pricing & Billing Master Data to apply the missing anniversary escalation in the price master from 2025-01-05. (2) Prepare a supplementary invoice for the under-billed lines for approval."}
